headline: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process; first CoC meeting scheduled 23 July 2026
sum: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited has initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. The company notified the NSE on 21 July 2026 of the first Committee of Creditors (CoC) meeting scheduled for 23 July 2026.
detail: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited, a publicly listed sugar manufacturer based in Uttar Pradesh, has entered CIRP. The company formally intimated the NSE of the first CoC meeting scheduled for Thursday, 23 July 2026, triggering mandatory disclosure obligations. The CoC will constitute the creditor body responsible for approving the Insolvency Professional's preliminary report, evaluating resolution plans, and determining the path to either resolution or liquidation under the IBC regime.
